lines: Sky-nature having abandoned, being present as existence only; trident equal-taste having made, in taste taste like standing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ākāśabhāvaṃ santyajya sattāmātramupasthitaḥ śūlaṃ samarasaṃ kṛtvā rase rasa iva sthitaḥ
